items.Sentence: the wastewater collection system consists of approximately 4,200 linear feet of 6-inch pipe, six septic tanks, and four pump stations.
From the septic tanks, the wastewater is either pumped or gravity flows into the evaporation/percolation pond.
wastewater generated at the MLSRA is piped via gravity and force mains to an approximately half-acre unlined evaporation/percolation pond located south of the WWTF.
3,080 gallons of sludge were removed by a contract service.
